ev.abwarten.label: Wait deliberately
ev.abwarten.beschr: You let happen what is shown under “Without a response”.
ev.vs.kabinett: Cabinet: {richtung, select, mehr {more} other {less}} support from {n} ministers
n5.start.log.neu: {name} wins the presidential election {runde, select, erste {in the first round} other {in the run-off}} with {anteil, prozent, 1}. The {partei} wins {eigene} of 600 seats; together with {n, plural, one {its ally} other {its allies}} {partner, list}, the governing bloc holds {bloc} seats.
n5.start.log.neuAllein: {name} wins the presidential election {runde, select, erste {in the first round} other {in the run-off}} with {anteil, prozent, 1}. The {partei} wins {eigene} of 600 seats.
n5.start.log.duldung: The {partei} ({sitze} seats) formally stays in opposition and tolerates the government for eight months at first.
n5.start.log.mehrheit: A governing majority: laws and budgets are possible as long as the partners stay in the bloc. They expect their demands to be met; break a promise and you lose them. Constitutional amendments still need {schwelle} votes.
n5.start.log.minderheit: No majority of your own: laws are {fehlt, plural, one {# vote} other {# votes}} short. You need partners, deals or defectors.
n5.zusage.duldung: In return for its support, the {partei} expects {forderung}
n5.schwer.entspannt.name: Relaxed
n5.schwer.normal.name: Normal
n5.schwer.hart.name: Hard
n5.schwer.entspannt.text: More capital, less fatigue, fewer crises. For getting to know the game.
n5.schwer.normal.text: The game as it is meant to be played.
n5.schwer.hart.text: Scarce capital, fast fatigue, more and harsher crises. Mistakes cost re-election.
n5.schwer.werte: Capital per month {kapital}%, frequency of crises {ereignisse}%, their severity {haerte}%, government fatigue {muedigkeit}% of “Normal”.
n5.gesetz.eingebracht: Bill “{name}” {ort} introduced at level {stufe}. The vote is in {tage, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}; once passed, implementation takes about {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}.
n5.gesetz.eingebrachtWarum: {pk} capital paid. {ja} yes votes are expected (range {low} to {high}); {noetig} are needed.
n5.gesetz.verzug: The introduction is delayed by two days: under strain you lack focus.
ev.standardHinweis: This happens if you let the deadline pass. Silence also costs {d, number, 1} points of approval.
ev.standardHinweis.start: This happens if you let the deadline pass.
ev.erdbeben.text1: An earthquake of magnitude {mag, number, 1} strikes {orte, list} (population {n, number}). {schaden, select, leicht {Damage to individual buildings is reported} mittel {Several neighbourhoods are reported badly damaged} other {Houses have collapsed and many people are left homeless}}.
ev.erdbeben.text2: {wer} asks for your instructions. Rescue teams are on their way; the question is how the state will act in the weeks and months ahead.
ev.erdbeben.warum: How hard it hits depends on the province's building quality and earthquake preparedness (here {v, number} out of 100). Old housing and weak building inspection make the difference.
ev.erdbeben.opt.fonds.label: State of emergency and a reconstruction fund
ev.erdbeben.opt.fonds.beschr: Fast-tracked contracts rebuild quickly but make corruption more likely.
ev.erdbeben.opt.fonds.ausgang: A reconstruction fund is set up; contracts move fast, but not always cleanly.
ev.erdbeben.opt.nothilfe.label: Emergency aid and tents only
ev.erdbeben.opt.nothilfe.beschr: Reconstruction is left to the province; trust suffers.
ev.erdbeben.opt.nothilfe.ausgang: The state provides emergency aid and leaves reconstruction to those affected and the province.
ev.erdbeben.opt.untersuchung.label: Investigate building inspectors and contractors
ev.erdbeben.opt.untersuchung.beschr: Honest but slow: better preparedness and less corruption.
ev.erdbeben.opt.untersuchung.ausgang: An inquiry into building inspection begins; contractors and municipalities come under pressure.
ev.erdbeben.standard: The state responds too late; those affected feel abandoned.
ev.duerre.text1: For weeks there has been hardly any rain in {orte, list}. The grain harvest is at risk and the reservoirs are half empty.
ev.duerre.text2: The farmers' union is calling for help, and the cities are talking about water rationing. {wer} points to the state of the budget.
ev.duerre.warum: Water supply, irrigation and reservoirs decide whether a dry season turns into a crisis.
ev.duerre.opt.hilfe.label: Emergency aid for farmers
ev.duerre.opt.hilfe.beschr: Farmers' incomes and part of the harvest are saved.
ev.duerre.opt.hilfe.ausgang: Farmers receive emergency aid and water deliveries.
ev.duerre.opt.import.label: Import grain
ev.duerre.opt.import.beschr: Keeps prices down but hurts producers.
ev.duerre.opt.import.ausgang: Grain is imported; prices calm down and farmers grumble.
ev.duerre.opt.rationieren.label: Ration drinking water in the cities
ev.duerre.opt.rationieren.beschr: Trust falls, but the water supply holds.
ev.duerre.opt.rationieren.ausgang: Water is rationed; it is unpopular, but supply holds.
ev.duerre.standard: Without a decision the situation worsens: harvests fail and water runs short.
ev.waehrungsrutsch.text1: The lira is losing value fast on the markets ({kurs, number, 1} to the dollar); the risk premium stands at {rp, number} basis points.
ev.waehrungsrutsch.text2: {wer1} and {wer2} are waiting for a signal. Interest rates are set by the central bank, not by you.
ev.waehrungsrutsch.warum: The currency responds to the inflation gap, interest rates, the risk premium and confidence. Short-term interventions buy time but do not fix the cause.
ev.waehrungsrutsch.opt.reserven.label: Use foreign-exchange reserves
ev.waehrungsrutsch.opt.reserven.beschr: The central bank sells dollars and props up the lira for a few weeks. If reserves run low, credibility suffers.
ev.waehrungsrutsch.opt.reserven.ausgang: The central bank sells reserves; the lira recovers as long as they last. {info}
ev.waehrungsrutsch.opt.reserven.scheiter: {info} The attempt to prop up the lira fails for lack of reserves; the markets read it as weakness.
ev.waehrungsrutsch.opt.kapital.label: Restrict capital flows
ev.waehrungsrutsch.opt.kapital.beschr: Strongly supports the lira but scares off investors and feeds the black market.
ev.waehrungsrutsch.opt.kapital.ausgang: Capital flows are restricted; the lira steadies and foreign money pulls out.
ev.waehrungsrutsch.opt.ruhe.label: Stay calm and back the central bank
ev.waehrungsrutsch.opt.ruhe.beschr: Helps in the long run; the pressure stays for now.
ev.waehrungsrutsch.opt.ruhe.ausgang: You publicly commit to the central bank's independence.
ev.waehrungsrutsch.standard: Without a signal, the sell-off continues.
ev.energiepreisschock.text1: World energy prices are {p, number} per cent above normal. Türkiye imports most of its energy.
ev.energiepreisschock.text2: Electricity, gas and petrol bills are climbing. The opposition talks of a winter of empty wallets.
ev.energiepreisschock.warum: Energy imports weigh on the trade balance, the lira and inflation at once; subsidies soften the bills and burden the budget.
ev.energiepreisschock.opt.deckel.label: Cap prices (subsidies)
ev.energiepreisschock.opt.deckel.beschr: Relieves households; the state pays the difference.
ev.energiepreisschock.opt.deckel.ausgang: Energy prices are capped; the state covers the difference.
ev.energiepreisschock.opt.haerte.label: Pass prices on, support hardship cases
ev.energiepreisschock.opt.haerte.beschr: Honest but painful: the cost of living rises and trust falls.
ev.energiepreisschock.opt.haerte.ausgang: Prices are passed on; hardship cases receive grants.
ev.energiepreisschock.opt.sparen.label: Appeal for savings and a speed limit
ev.energiepreisschock.opt.sparen.beschr: Little effect: slightly fewer imports, slightly less trust.
ev.energiepreisschock.opt.sparen.ausgang: An appeal to save energy goes out to households and businesses.
ev.haushaltsdruck.titel: The rating agencies issue a warning
ev.haushaltsdruck.text1: Several rating agencies signal a downgrade: debt stands at {schulden, prozent, 1} of GDP and the risk premium at {rp, number} basis points.
ev.haushaltsdruck.text2: {wer} wants a signal that the budget is under control.
ev.haushaltsdruck.warum: Higher risk premiums make borrowing dearer; a government that loses control of its budget pays with interest and a weak currency.
ev.haushaltsdruck.opt.sparpaket.label: Austerity package
ev.haushaltsdruck.opt.sparpaket.beschr: The markets calm down and the finance ministry is pleased; trust at home falls.
ev.haushaltsdruck.opt.sparpaket.ausgang: An austerity package is announced; the markets breathe easier and the country grumbles.
ev.haushaltsdruck.opt.steuer.label: Raise taxes
ev.haushaltsdruck.opt.steuer.beschr: Brings in revenue but hits households.
ev.haushaltsdruck.opt.steuer.ausgang: Taxes go up; the hole in the budget shrinks.
ev.haushaltsdruck.opt.wachstum.label: Bet on growth
ev.haushaltsdruck.opt.wachstum.beschr: The markets don't believe it; the risk premium rises.
ev.haushaltsdruck.opt.wachstum.ausgang: You promise to grow out of the problems; the markets are sceptical.
ev.haushaltsdruck.standard: The agencies downgrade the country; borrowing becomes more expensive.
ev.korruptionsaffaere.v.vergabe.text: A report reveals that a major construction contract went to a firm close to the government without a genuine tender.
ev.korruptionsaffaere.v.vergabe.familie: A report reveals that a construction firm linked to your family won a state contract without a genuine tender.
ev.korruptionsaffaere.v.beschaffung.text: A newspaper publishes documents showing that the defence ministry ordered equipment from a single supplier at grossly inflated prices.
ev.korruptionsaffaere.v.klinik.text: The Court of Accounts finds that a hospital group bought equipment and medicines through a middleman owned by a party friend.
ev.korruptionsaffaere.v.energie.text: Opposition MPs produce contracts under which a state utility must buy power at fixed prices from plants owned by a government ally.
ev.korruptionsaffaere.text2: {wer} urges a quick decision before the opposition sets the story.
ev.korruptionsaffaere.warum: Corruption grows out of weak oversight, time pressure and closeness. It damages trust and cannot simply be brushed aside.
ev.korruptionsaffaere.opt.aufklaeren.bes: Trust dips for now; less corruption and more faith in the courts pay off later.
ev.korruptionsaffaere.opt.abwiegeln.ausg: The government rejects the allegations; the press keeps digging.
ev.korruptionsaffaere.opt.opfern.label: Let someone take the fall
ev.korruptionsaffaere.opt.opfern.beschr: A cabinet member loses their post.
ev.korruptionsaffaere.opt.opfern.ausgang: {wer} resigns; the affair loses its edge.
ev.korruptionsaffaere.standard: The affair grows; the impression of a cover-up sticks.
ev.streikwelle.text1: Workers in {orte, list} are walking out. Wages are not keeping up with prices (inflation {inflation, prozent, 1}).
ev.streikwelle.text2: The unions demand compensation for inflation; employers warn of costs and lay-offs.
ev.streikwelle.warum: When prices rise faster than wages, the willingness to strike grows. Pay concessions calm it but push up business costs and with them inflation.
ev.streikwelle.opt.lohn.label: Pay concession
ev.streikwelle.opt.lohn.beschr: Calms workers but adds to cost pressure.
ev.streikwelle.opt.lohn.ausgang: The state gives way on pay; the strikes end and businesses groan.
ev.streikwelle.opt.verbot.label: Ban the strikes
ev.streikwelle.opt.verbot.beschr: Suppresses the strikes for a while and weakens union rights for good; the divide deepens.
ev.streikwelle.opt.vermitteln.label: Mediate
ev.streikwelle.standard: The strikes go on; output and trust suffer.
ev.mietproteste.text1: Thousands of tenants take to the streets in {orte, list}: rents are eating up incomes.
ev.mietproteste.text2: Landlords and developers warn that intervention will choke off new building.
ev.mietproteste.warum: High rents reflect supply and demand in the city; a cap brings instant relief but cuts new building over time.
ev.mietproteste.opt.deckel.label: Cap rents
ev.mietproteste.opt.deckel.beschr: Works at once but slows new building.
ev.mietproteste.opt.deckel.ausgang: Rents are capped; property investors pull back.
ev.mietproteste.opt.sozial.label: Promise social housing
ev.mietproteste.opt.sozial.beschr: Eases the housing shortage a little straight away and wins over young people; the state bears the cost.
ev.mietproteste.opt.sozial.ausgang: A social housing programme is announced; the housing shortage eases a little.
ev.mietproteste.opt.raeumen.label: Break up the protests
ev.mietproteste.opt.raeumen.beschr: Hardens the fronts, above all among young people and in the cities.
ev.mietproteste.opt.raeumen.ausgang: Police break up the protests; the anger remains.
ev.mietproteste.standard: The protests grow; no one feels responsible.
ev.fluechtlingswelle.titel: New refugee movement at the border
ev.fluechtlingswelle.text1: More people are arriving at the southern border again, mostly from Syria; at first they stay in {orte, list}. These provinces are already under strain.
ev.fluechtlingswelle.text2: {wer1} and {wer2} disagree on what to do.
ev.fluechtlingswelle.warum: Migration ties together domestic, foreign and economic policy: border protection, reception, integration and talks with the EU each carry a different price.
ev.fluechtlingswelle.opt.grenze.label: Secure the border (decree)
ev.fluechtlingswelle.opt.grenze.beschr: Fewer arrivals; Brussels welcomes it and conservatives rally behind you.
ev.fluechtlingswelle.opt.grenze.ausgang: The border is tightened; arrivals fall.
ev.fluechtlingswelle.opt.aufnehmen.label: Take people in and integrate them
ev.fluechtlingswelle.opt.aufnehmen.besch: Humane but politically risky: relations with the EU improve, while pressure in the provinces and conservative discontent grow.
ev.fluechtlingswelle.opt.aufnehmen.ausga: People are taken in; the provinces receive support and opinion stays divided.
ev.fluechtlingswelle.opt.eu.label: Negotiate with the EU
ev.fluechtlingswelle.opt.eu.beschr: The EU pays for the border provinces; in return, more refugees stay in the country.
ev.fluechtlingswelle.opt.eu.ausgang: An agreement with the EU brings money for the border provinces.
ev.fluechtlingswelle.standard: Without a decision, pressure in the border provinces grows.
ev.anschlag.text1: An attack shakes {orte, list}. The authorities speak of an organised act; the situation is still unclear.
ev.anschlag.text2: {wer} demands sweeping powers. The country is waiting to hear from you.
ev.anschlag.warum: After attacks, calls for toughness grow. More powers bring security but cost freedom and the trust of liberals.
ev.anschlag.opt.paket.label: Security package with wider powers
ev.anschlag.opt.paket.beschr: Backing from conservatives, criticism from liberals; police and gendarmerie gain wider powers for good.
ev.anschlag.opt.besonnen.label: Restraint and investigation
ev.anschlag.opt.besonnen.beschr: Dignified and builds trust, but leaves you open to attack.
ev.anschlag.opt.besonnen.ausgang: You call for calm; the investigation is under way.
ev.anschlag.standard: Without a clear answer the government looks helpless.
ev.waldbrand.text1: Forests are burning in {orte, list}; villages are being evacuated and smoke hangs over the coastal towns in the middle of the holiday season.
ev.waldbrand.warum: Heat, drought and a lack of firefighting capacity hit the coast especially hard: tourism and air quality suffer too.
ev.waldbrand.opt.loeschen.label: Firefighting aircraft and emergency aid
ev.waldbrand.opt.loeschen.beschr: The fires are contained; tourism partly recovers.
ev.waldbrand.opt.loeschen.ausgang: Firefighting aircraft and crews are deployed; the fires are contained.
ev.waldbrand.opt.entschaedigen.label: Evacuate and compensate those affected
ev.waldbrand.opt.entschaedigen.beschr: Those affected feel looked after; trust grows.
ev.waldbrand.opt.entschaedigen.ausgang: Those affected are housed and compensated.
ev.waldbrand.standard: The fires spread; help comes late.
ev.stromausfaelle.text1: For days the power has kept failing in {orte, list}. Factories stand idle and hospitals run on emergency generators.
ev.stromausfaelle.warum: Grids, storage and imports decide whether peak demand can be met.
ev.stromausfaelle.opt.ration.label: Ration industry
ev.stromausfaelle.opt.ration.beschr: Keeps households on the grid; businesses lose out.
ev.stromausfaelle.opt.ration.ausgang: Industry is temporarily taken off the grid.
ev.stromausfaelle.opt.import.label: Emergency imports
ev.stromausfaelle.opt.import.beschr: Stabilises the grid quickly but increases dependence on imports.
ev.stromausfaelle.opt.import.ausgang: Electricity is bought in from abroad.
ev.stromausfaelle.standard: The outages continue; anger at the government grows.
ev.aerztestreik.text1: Doctors in {orte, list} are walking out in protest at pay and working conditions. Many are openly thinking about going abroad.
ev.aerztestreik.warum: Doctor shortages arise when pay and conditions fall behind. They hit the provinces away from the big cities first.
ev.aerztestreik.opt.gehalt.label: Raise salaries
ev.aerztestreik.opt.gehalt.ausgang: Salaries in the health service go up.
ev.aerztestreik.opt.ausland.label: Recruit doctors from abroad
ev.aerztestreik.opt.ausland.beschr: Brings some relief but keeps no one from leaving.
ev.aerztestreik.opt.ausland.ausgang: A programme recruits doctors from abroad.
ev.aerztestreik.standard: The protests go on; doctors leave the country.
ev.preisdeckel_knappheit.text1: Under the price cap, shops barely stock some staple foods any more. On grey markets they cost twice as much.
ev.preisdeckel_knappheit.warum: A cap below the market price makes goods vanish or move to grey markets: the visible price falls, reality does not.
ev.preisdeckel_knappheit.opt.lockern.bes: Goods come back and prices rise.
ev.preisdeckel_knappheit.opt.importieren: More goods on the shelves; food prices fall a little.
ev.preisdeckel_knappheit.opt.durchhalten: The black market grows and small businesses suffer.
Traders are punished; goods stay scarce.
ev.preisdeckel_knappheit.standard: The shelves stay empty; discontent grows.
ev.mietdeckel_folgen.text1: Since the rent cap, hardly any rental housing is being built; investors are moving into other assets. The construction industry is complaining.
ev.mietdeckel_folgen.warum: Capped rents help those who already have a home and hold back supply for everyone still looking.
ev.mietdeckel_folgen.opt.ausnahme.label: Exempt new buildings
ev.mietdeckel_folgen.opt.ausnahme.ausgan: New buildings are exempted from the cap.
ev.mietdeckel_folgen.opt.foerdern.label: Double building subsidies
ev.mietdeckel_folgen.opt.foerdern.beschr: Housing and construction pick up; the state pays.
ev.koalitionsangebot.text1: The {partei} ({sitze, plural, one {# seat} other {# seats}}) signals that it will back your camp in parliament if you meet it halfway.
ev.koalitionsangebot.text2: Its price: {preis}. Without a majority, legislation stays slow and costly.
ev.koalitionsangebot.warum: Without a majority of their own, a president needs partners. Every partner has its own voters and its own price.
ev.koalitionsangebot.opt.ablehnen.label: Decline
ev.koalitionsangebot.opt.ablehnen.beschr: Your majority stays hard to find; the party is put out, though less than if the offer lapsed unanswered.
ev.koalitionsangebot.opt.ablehnen.ausgan: The offer is declined; the party remembers the refusal.
ev.koalitionsangebot.standard: The offer lapses unanswered; the party feels ignored.
ev.start_haushalt.text1: {wer} presents the draft: inflation is at {inflation, prozent, 1} and debt at {schulden, prozent, 1} of GDP. The markets are watching whether the new government keeps discipline.
ev.start_haushalt.text2: The draft leaves room to move either way.
ev.start_haushalt.warum: More spending props up demand for a while and drives up inflation and debt; saving calms the markets and costs approval.
ev.start_haushalt.opt.sparen.label: Austerity course
ev.start_haushalt.opt.sparen.beschr: Calms the markets and pleases the finance ministry; approval dips slightly.
ev.start_haushalt.opt.mitte.label: Balanced
ev.start_haushalt.opt.mitte.ausgang: The budget stays as it is.
ev.start_haushalt.opt.wachstum.label: Growth budget
ev.start_haushalt.opt.wachstum.beschr: More investment and more debt; the finance ministry is unhappy.
ev.start_haushalt.opt.wachstum.ausgang: The budget bets on growth and investment.
ev.start_haushalt.standard: The budget stays as it is.
ev.start_partner.text1: {g, select, f {The {partei} leader, {name},} m {The {partei} leader, {name},} other {The {partei} leadership}} recalls the campaign: {zusage}. An answer is expected within the first week.
ev.start_partner.warum: Promises are capital: keep them and you are taken seriously; break them and you pay later.
ev.start_partner.opt.knapp.label: Make a modest offer
ev.start_partner.opt.knapp.beschr: The party grumbles but stays on board.
ev.start_partner.opt.knapp.ausgang: The offer is a modest one.
ev.start_partner.opt.vertagen.label: Postpone
ev.start_partner.opposition.text1: The opposition demands that you keep your campaign promises within the first hundred days and says it will keep a careful count.
ev.start_partner.opposition.opt.liste.la: Publish a list of your promises
ev.start_partner.opposition.opt.liste.be: Creates transparency and pressure; trust rises slightly.
ev.start_partner.opposition.opt.liste.au: You publish your promises and face the count.
ev.start_wiederaufbau.text1: In the provinces hit by the 2023 earthquake, reconstruction is not finished. Many families still live in containers.
ev.start_wiederaufbau.text2: {wer} presents the report: building fast saves time, building properly saves lives when the next quake comes.
ev.start_wiederaufbau.warum: Reconstruction competes with everything else for money, staff and materials; haste and corruption increase vulnerability.
ev.start_wiederaufbau.opt.chefsache.besc: Fast reconstruction; the haste makes corruption more likely.
ev.start_wiederaufbau.opt.chefsache.ausg: Reconstruction becomes your personal priority; contracts move fast.
ev.start_wiederaufbau.opt.sauber.label: Build properly, with inspections
ev.start_wiederaufbau.opt.sauber.beschr: Slower but safer: better building quality and earthquake preparedness.
ev.start_wiederaufbau.opt.sauber.ausgang: Reconstruction follows strict inspections: slower, but safer.
ev.start_wiederaufbau.opt.weiter.label: Keep things as they are
ev.start_wiederaufbau.opt.weiter.beschr: The region keeps waiting; trust dips slightly.
ev.start_wiederaufbau.opt.weiter.ausgang: Reconstruction continues at its current pace.
ev.start_wiederaufbau.standard: Reconstruction continues at its current pace.
ev.erbe.ad.phanar: the Ecumenical Patriarchate at the Phanar
ev.erbe.ad.myra: the Church of St Nicholas at Myra
ev.erbe.ad.antakya: the old town of Antakya and its mosaic museum
ev.erbe.ad.meryem_ana: the House of the Virgin Mary
ev.erbe.ad.divrigi: the Great Mosque and Hospital of Divriği
ev.erbe.ad.diyarbakir: Diyarbakır Fortress and the Hevsel Gardens
ev.erbe_raubgrabung.text1: Guards report night-time digging at {ad}{mitort, select, ja { in {ort}} other {}}: holes in the ground, traces of metal detectors, and a dealer abroad is offering pieces that may come from the area.
ev.erbe_raubgrabung.text2: The law on cultural and natural property sets two to five years in prison for illegal digging, but there are too few guards.
ev.erbe_raubgrabung.warum: Heritage that nobody guards is lost piece by piece: to theft, to decay and to indifference.
ev.erbe_raubgrabung.opt.schutz.label: Add guards and send investigators
ev.erbe_raubgrabung.opt.schutz.beschr: The site is secured and investigators go after the culprits.
ev.erbe_raubgrabung.opt.schutz.ausgang: The site at {ad} is now guarded; investigators are tracking the dealers.
ev.erbe_raubgrabung.opt.grabung.label: Take over the excavation and secure the finds
ev.erbe_raubgrabung.opt.grabung.ausgang: Archaeologists take over the dig at {ad} and secure the finds.
ev.erbe_raubgrabung.standard: The looters carry on; finds at {ad} are lost.
ev.erbe_erdbebenschaden.text1: A magnitude 5 earthquake brings down walls at {ad}{mitort, select, ja { in {ort}} other {}} and cracks load-bearing structures. Surveyors warn that if the site is left unsecured, the next rain could destroy the rest.
ev.erbe_erdbebenschaden.text2: In 2023 Antakya lost more than half of its historic buildings; that must not happen again.
ev.erbe_erdbebenschaden.warum: In an earthquake country, heritage is lost not only to age but in single nights; prevention is cheaper than rebuilding.
ev.erbe_erdbebenschaden.opt.sichern.labe: Secure it now: props, roofs, surveyors
ev.erbe_erdbebenschaden.opt.zusagen.besc: A promise that will be called in later.
ev.erbe_erdbebenschaden.standard: Nobody secures {ad}; the next rain does the rest.
ev.erbe_unesco.text1: UNESCO's World Heritage Committee meets in July. Türkiye has nominated {ad}{mitort, select, ja { in {ort}} other {}} for the List; the site's condition stands at {zustand, number} out of 100. The assessors want a conservation plan, visitor management and contacts on site.
ev.erbe_unesco.text2: Sardis was inscribed in 2025 after years of preparation.
ev.erbe_unesco.warum: World Heritage status depends on condition, management and diplomacy; it brings visitors and prestige, and obliges you to care for the site and report on it.
ev.erbe_unesco.opt.betreiben.label: Push the bid with full force
ev.erbe_unesco.opt.betreiben.beschr: Diplomacy, assessors and a conservation plan; the outcome is open.
ev.erbe_unesco.opt.betreiben.ausgang.ja: UNESCO inscribes {ad} on the World Heritage List.
ev.erbe_unesco.opt.betreiben.ausgang.nei: The committee defers its decision on {ad}: the conservation plan is not yet convincing.
ev.erbe_unesco.opt.zurueck.label: Shelve the bid and secure the site first
ev.erbe_unesco.opt.zurueck.beschr: The site gains; the title has to wait.
ev.erbe_unesco.opt.zurueck.ausgang: Ankara shelves the bid for {ad} and secures the site first.
ev.erbe_unesco.standard: With nothing from Ankara, the committee puts the bid off.
ev.erbe_fund.text1: The excavation team at {ad}{mitort, select, ja { in {ort}} other {}} reports a find that could change what is known about the past: a structure older than assumed, with reliefs and inscriptions. The press has already heard about it.
ev.erbe_fund.text2: Since Göbekli Tepe, everyone knows what a discovery can mean for a region: it draws visitors at once.
ev.erbe_fund.warum: Discoveries put a country on the map, but protection and research take time; celebrating too early risks damage and theft.
ev.erbe_fund.opt.offen.label: Announce it now and promise a museum
ev.erbe_fund.opt.offen.beschr: Attention and visitors, but the crowds take their toll on the site.
ev.erbe_fund.opt.offen.ausgang: The government announces the find at {ad} and promises a museum.
ev.erbe_fund.opt.sichern.label: Secure it scientifically first, then report
ev.erbe_fund.opt.sichern.ausgang: Scientists document the find at {ad} before it is made public.
ev.erbe_fund.standard: With no decision, pictures leak out; soon onlookers crowd {ad}.
ev.erbe_hagia_sophia.text1: On the anniversary of its reconversion, associations, churches and museum experts are once again arguing over the use of Hagia Sophia: a place of prayer for some, world heritage for others, a destination for millions of visitors.
ev.erbe_hagia_sophia.text2: It has been a mosque again since July 2020, a step UNESCO regretted. Foreign visitors pay for entry.
ev.erbe_hagia_sophia.warum: A building can be sacred to more than one community; every change to the visiting rules is read politically.
ev.erbe_hagia_sophia.opt.offen.label: Open visiting hours to all faiths
ev.erbe_hagia_sophia.opt.offen.beschr: Diversity and prestige, but protests from conservatives.
ev.erbe_hagia_sophia.opt.offen.ausgang: The government sets fixed hours for visitors of all faiths.
ev.erbe_hagia_sophia.opt.gebuehr.label: Raise the entry fee for foreigners
ev.erbe_hagia_sophia.opt.gebuehr.ausgang: Entry for foreign visitors goes up; it brings in revenue and eases the crowds.
ev.erbe_hagia_sophia.standard: With no decision, the dispute goes on.
ev.kultur_pilgerwelle.titel: A wave of pilgrims on the church route
ev.kultur_pilgerwelle.text1: For the church holiday, far more pilgrims and tour groups arrive than the ‘{route}’ can handle: coaches queue in Selçuk, Bergama runs out of rooms, and visitors crowd the synagogue at Sardis.
ev.kultur_pilgerwelle.text2: This is the success that was wanted, and the strain the heritage authorities warned about.
ev.kultur_pilgerwelle.warum: Success brings strain: whoever attracts visitors has to manage them, or the site pays.
ev.kultur_pilgerwelle.opt.lenken.label: Expand lodging and visitor management
ev.kultur_pilgerwelle.opt.lenken.beschr: Protects the sites and brings a few more visitors.
ev.kultur_pilgerwelle.opt.lenken.ausgang: Stewards, car parks and guided tours steer the pilgrims.
ev.kultur_pilgerwelle.opt.laufen.label: Let it run
ev.kultur_pilgerwelle.opt.laufen.beschr: More visitors, but more wear on the sites.
ev.kultur_pilgerwelle.opt.laufen.ausgang: Pilgrims arrive in droves; the sites bear the load.
ev.kultur_pilgerwelle.standard: The crowds go unmanaged; the sites suffer.
ev.recht_ernennung.titel: A seat on the Constitutional Court falls vacant
ev.recht_ernennung.text1: A member of the Constitutional Court is retiring. As head of state you appoint twelve of the fifteen members; now you must name someone for the vacant seat.
ev.recht_ernennung.text2: The court now has {loyal, plural, one {# judge close to the government} other {# judges close to the government}}, {reform, plural, one {# reformer} other {# reformers}} and {unabhaengig, plural, one {# independent} other {# independents}}. Each appointment shifts the balance for twelve years.
ev.recht_ernennung.warum: Whoever fills the seats shapes whether the courts stop government plans: loyalty buys calm, independence buys credibility.
ev.recht_ernennung.opt.loyal.label: Appoint a lawyer from your own circle
ev.recht_ernennung.opt.loyal.beschr: Safe for the government, costly for judicial independence.
ev.recht_ernennung.opt.loyal.ausgang: You appoint a lawyer from your own circle.
ev.recht_ernennung.opt.unabhaengig.label: Appoint a respected, independent jurist
ev.recht_ernennung.opt.unabhaengig.besch: Credibility at home and abroad, less control.
ev.recht_ernennung.opt.unabhaengig.ausga: You appoint an independent jurist; legal experts praise the choice.
ev.recht_ernennung.opt.kompromiss.label: Find a candidate the opposition can also back
ev.recht_ernennung.opt.kompromiss.beschr: A compromise that brings both camps on board.
ev.recht_ernennung.opt.kompromiss.ausgan: After talks with the opposition, a candidate is agreed whom both camps support.
ev.recht_ernennung.standard: You let the deadline pass; the seat goes to a candidate from your circle.
ev.recht_aym_kassation.titel: Constitutional Court versus Court of Cassation
ev.recht_aym_kassation.text1: The Court of Cassation refuses to implement a Constitutional Court ruling ordering the release of an elected MP: the ruling, it says, has ‘no legal force’. Once again, court stands against court.
ev.recht_aym_kassation.text2: Lawyers and the opposition demand that the government enforce the ruling; circles close to the government back the Court of Cassation.
ev.recht_aym_kassation.warum: When the highest courts refuse to recognise each other, what is at stake is whether rulings count for anything; the government holds no neutral office in this dispute.
ev.recht_aym_kassation.opt.durchsetzen.b: Strengthens the judiciary, angers your own camp.
ev.recht_aym_kassation.opt.durchsetzen.a: The government ensures that the Constitutional Court ruling is implemented.
ev.recht_aym_kassation.opt.kassation.bes: Calm in your own camp, damage to prestige and the rule of law.
ev.recht_aym_kassation.opt.kassation.aus: The government backs the Court of Cassation; the ruling goes unimplemented.
ev.recht_aym_kassation.standard: The clash between the courts remains unresolved; trust in both falls.
ev.recht_egmr.text1: The European Court of Human Rights finds that Türkiye has violated the Convention in yet another case. Few member states of the Council of Europe are found against in Strasbourg so often.
ev.recht_egmr.text2: The Council of Europe's Committee of Ministers asks whether and when the government will implement the ruling.
ev.recht_egmr.warum: Rulings from Strasbourg are binding; failing to implement them piles up cases and accusations.
ev.recht_egmr.opt.umsetzen.label: Implement the ruling
ev.recht_egmr.opt.umsetzen.beschr: Eases relations with Strasbourg and Brussels, angers your own camp.
ev.recht_egmr.opt.umsetzen.ausgang: The government implements the Strasbourg ruling.
ev.recht_egmr.opt.zurueck.label: Reject the ruling
ev.recht_egmr.opt.zurueck.beschr: Applause at home, pressure from abroad.
ev.recht_egmr.opt.zurueck.ausgang: The government rejects the Strasbourg ruling.
ev.recht_egmr.standard: The ruling is left untouched; the Committee of Ministers' list grows.
ev.recht_haftrevolte.text1: Unrest breaks out in a prison built for half as many people: inmates refuse food and a wing is on fire. Relatives wait at the gate.
ev.recht_haftrevolte.text2: Prison overcrowding stands at {wert, number} out of 100; many inmates are on remand, still awaiting trial.
ev.recht_haftrevolte.warum: Overcrowding is a policy question: it comes from detention practice and capacity, and it erupts on nights like this.
ev.recht_haftrevolte.opt.verlegen.label: Transfer inmates now and create places
ev.recht_haftrevolte.opt.verlegen.ausgan: Inmates are transferred and extra places are set up.
ev.recht_haftrevolte.opt.haerte.label: Take a hard line
ev.recht_haftrevolte.opt.haerte.ausgang: Special forces end the unrest by force.
ev.recht_haftrevolte.opt.vermeidung.labe: Announce alternatives to custody and probation
ev.recht_haftrevolte.opt.vermeidung.besc: Relieves the pressure slowly and builds trust in the courts; conservatives grumble.
ev.recht_haftrevolte.opt.vermeidung.ausg: The government announces it will curb pre-trial detention.
ev.recht_haftrevolte.standard: The situation in the prison spirals out of control; reports go round the world.
ev.mil_lieferverzug.text1: The manufacturers report a delay on the ‘{name}’ programme: a supplier part is missing, acceptance is postponed and training is falling behind.
ev.mil_lieferverzug.text2: Delays are the norm in defence procurement; the question is who pays the price: the supplier, the troops or you.
ev.mil_lieferverzug.warum: Ordered is not ready for service: years pass between contract and readiness, and every disruption costs time or allies' patience.
ev.mil_lieferverzug.opt.druck.label: Put pressure on the supplier
ev.mil_lieferverzug.opt.druck.beschr: Makes up time, strains relations with the United States.
ev.mil_lieferverzug.opt.druck.ausgang: Ankara applies pressure: the supplier promises to catch up.
ev.mil_lieferverzug.opt.hinnehmen.label: Accept the delay
ev.mil_lieferverzug.opt.hinnehmen.beschr: Calm, but a gap in readiness.
ev.mil_lieferverzug.opt.hinnehmen.ausgan: The government accepts the delay; the programme slips back.
ev.mil_lieferverzug.opt.eigen.label: Bring domestic production forward
ev.mil_lieferverzug.opt.eigen.beschr: More self-reliance in defence, results only later.
ev.mil_lieferverzug.opt.eigen.ausgang: The procurement agency brings domestic production forward.
ev.mil_lieferverzug.standard: The delay continues; the programme loses time.
ev.mil_militaerrat.text1: In August the Supreme Military Council meets under your chairmanship: it decides on the promotion and retirement of generals and admirals.
ev.mil_militaerrat.text2: After the 2016 coup attempt, a large share of the generals were dismissed; who is promoted now shows the ranks what counts in this country.
ev.mil_militaerrat.warum: How the top brass is chosen decides whether officers look to merit or to connections. Loyalty buys calm, merit buys readiness.
ev.mil_militaerrat.opt.leistung.label: Promote on merit
ev.mil_militaerrat.opt.leistung.beschr: Trust and readiness, but less control.
ev.mil_militaerrat.opt.leistung.ausgang: The council promotes on merit and qualifications.
ev.mil_militaerrat.opt.loyalitaet.label: Promote on loyalty
ev.mil_militaerrat.opt.loyalitaet.beschr: Wins you backing at the top; distrust grows in the ranks.
ev.mil_militaerrat.opt.loyalitaet.ausgan: The council promotes officers close to you.
ev.mil_militaerrat.opt.generalstab.label: Confirm the General Staff's proposals
ev.mil_militaerrat.opt.generalstab.ausga: The council confirms the General Staff's proposals.
ev.mil_militaerrat.standard: The council meets without your guidance; the General Staff gets its way.
ev.infra_bauunfall.text1: Scaffolding collapses on the ‘{name}’ site; workers are injured and several die. Unions and families demand answers.
ev.infra_bauunfall.text2: Officially 27 workers died building Istanbul Airport; the figure remained disputed.
ev.infra_bauunfall.warum: Major projects are built under time pressure; when administration and inspection are overstretched, the workers pay.
ev.infra_bauunfall.opt.aufklaeren.label: Inquiry and safety programme
ev.infra_bauunfall.opt.aufklaeren.beschr: Helps the workers, sets the build back.
ev.infra_bauunfall.opt.aufklaeren.ausgan: Work stops, an independent inquiry begins and a safety programme follows.
ev.infra_bauunfall.opt.decken.label: Cover for the contractor
ev.infra_bauunfall.opt.decken.ausgang: The government covers for the contractor; work continues.
ev.infra_bauunfall.standard: Without a clear answer, the anger of families and unions grows.
ev.person.rolle.generalstab: {g, select, other {Chief of the General Staff}}
ev.person.ausscheiden.warum: {grund}. An acting head takes over; markets and the press watch who comes next.
ev.person.entlasse.log.kommissarisch: The President dismisses {alt} and installs {neu} on an acting basis.
ev.person.entlasse.warum.finanzen: Markets react nervously to a change at the Finance Ministry.
ev.person.entlasse.warum.allg: A cabinet change costs capital and makes enemies.
ev.person_ruecktritt.text1: {wer} has sent word that {g, select, f {she} other {he}} will not carry on under these conditions. Loyalty stands at {loy, number} out of 100, and {g, select, f {she} other {he}} seems {groll}.
ev.person_ruecktritt.text.leer: A member of the government threatens to resign.
ev.person_ruecktritt.warum: Keep people in office who no longer follow you and you pay in performance; let them go and you pay in resentment, market jitters and a new start. Win them back and you pay in capital.
ev.person_ruecktritt.opt.zugestaendnisse: {g, select, f {She stays} other {He stays}}, markedly more loyal and less aggrieved; the department gets more money and freedom for four months.
{wer} stays; the department receives extra funds for four months.
Kept on with concessions after threatening to resign
ev.person_ruecktritt.opt.aussprache.besc: {g, select, f {She agrees} other {He agrees}} to stay, but only half-heartedly: a little more loyal, a little less resentful.
ev.person_ruecktritt.opt.aussprache.ausg: {wer} stays for now, but the mood is poor.
ev.person_ruecktritt.opt.aussprache.merk: Talked it through after threatening to resign
ev.person_ruecktritt.opt.annehmen.label: Accept the resignation
ev.person_ruecktritt.opt.annehmen.beschr: {g, select, f {She leaves} other {He leaves}} bearing a grudge; an acting head takes over the department.
ev.person_ruecktritt.opt.annehmen.ausgan: {wer} resigns; an acting head takes over.
ev.person_ruecktritt.opt.annehmen.grund: Resigned after threatening to do so
ev.person_ruecktritt.standard: {wer} draws the conclusion and resigns; the government looks rudderless.
ev.person_skandal.text1: Several newspapers report that {wer} has {vorwurf}. {g, select, f {She} other {He}} denies everything; the opposition demands consequences.
ev.person_skandal.text2: Nobody knows for sure whether there is anything in it; {g, select, f {she} other {he}} has assured you there is not. Loyalty stands at {loy, number} out of 100.
ev.person_skandal.text.leer: Allegations are being made against a member of the government.
ev.person_skandal.vorwurf.finanzen: favoured an acquaintance in a ministry tender
ev.person_skandal.vorwurf.inneres: obstructed investigations into people close to the ministry
ev.person_skandal.vorwurf.aussen: failed to secure confidential papers from the negotiations
ev.person_skandal.vorwurf.stab: arranged meetings with the President for lobbyists
ev.person_skandal.vorwurf.generalstab: favoured a supplier in an arms procurement
ev.person_skandal.warum: A scandal is judged by what the President does: back the minister and you share the blame; drop them and you make an enemy and look arbitrary; order an inquiry and you need nerve.
ev.person_skandal.opt.pruefen.label: Allow an inquiry
ev.person_skandal.opt.pruefen.beschr: The inquiry settles it: if there is something in it, {g, select, f {she goes; if not, she is cleared} other {he goes; if not, he is cleared}}. Trust rises a little.
ev.person_skandal.opt.pruefen.ausgang.wa: The inquiry confirms the allegations: {wer} resigns, and you have acted cleanly.
ev.person_skandal.opt.pruefen.ausgang.fa: The inquiry clears {wer}: {g, select, f {she is} other {he is}} grateful that you investigated rather than condemned.
ev.person_skandal.opt.pruefen.grund: Resigned after the allegations were confirmed
ev.person_skandal.opt.stuetzen.label: Back them in public
ev.person_skandal.opt.stuetzen.beschr: {g, select, f {She becomes} other {He becomes}} more loyal; if there is anything in the allegations, you share the blame.
ev.person_skandal.opt.stuetzen.ausgang.w: Soon afterwards it emerges that there was something in the allegations; you have embarrassed yourself and trust falls markedly.
ev.person_skandal.opt.stuetzen.ausgang.f: The allegations fizzle out; your backing has paid off.
ev.person_skandal.opt.fallenlassen.label: Drop them
ev.person_skandal.opt.fallenlassen.besch: {g, select, f {She goes} other {He goes}} at once; if there was nothing in it, you look arbitrary.
ev.person_skandal.opt.fallenlassen.ausga: {wer} has to go without anything being cleared up.
ev.person_skandal.standard: The President stays silent; the press reads it as weakness, and {wer} feels let down.
ev.person_intrige.text1: Word from the parliamentary group is that {wer} is quietly pitching {g, select, f {herself} other {himself}} as the better choice for the leadership. Ambition stands at {ehrgeiz, number} out of 100, loyalty at {loy, number}.
ev.person_intrige.text.leer: Someone in the cabinet is building support against you.
ev.person_intrige.text2: For now it is only talk; do nothing and it may grow into a power base.
ev.person_intrige.warum: Ambitious people who are not given a role find one for themselves. Bringing them in costs resources, pushing them out makes an enemy, waiting costs you peace.
ev.person_intrige.opt.einbinden.label: Bring them in: more resources and responsibility
ev.person_intrige.opt.einbinden.beschr: {g, select, f {She reins in her} other {He reins in his}} ambition for as long as the recognition lasts: more loyalty, less resentment and extra funds for five months.
ev.person_intrige.opt.einbinden.ausgang: {wer} gets more resources and responsibility; the talk dies down for now.
ev.person_intrige.opt.einbinden.merke: Brought in after playing power games
ev.person_intrige.opt.entlassen.label: Remove
ev.person_intrige.opt.entlassen.beschr: {g, select, f {She has} other {He has}} to leave office; the resentment is deep, and an acting head takes over.
ev.person_intrige.opt.entlassen.ausgang: {wer} is forced out of office; an acting head takes over.
ev.person_intrige.opt.entlassen.grund: Removed by the President for playing power games
ev.person_intrige.opt.beobachten.label: Watch and wait
ev.person_intrige.opt.beobachten.beschr: No quarrel, but {g, select, f {she notices} other {he notices}} that you are not acting and grows more discontented.
ev.person_intrige.opt.beobachten.ausgang: You let {wer} carry on; {g, select, f {she} other {he}} keeps gathering support.
ev.person_intrige.standard: You do not react, and the power base of {wer} grows; the papers speak of a power struggle.
ev.person_leck.text1: A confidential government meeting is all over the papers: quotes, figures, a row over the course. Nobody knows who talked.
ev.person_leck.text2: Suspicion falls on whoever is aggrieved: the resentment of {wer} stands at {groll, number} out of 100.
ev.person_leck.text2.leer: Suspicion falls on whoever is aggrieved.
ev.person_leck.warum: People who are aggrieved and have nothing to lose talk. Hunting for the source costs trust in the cabinet; silence costs trust in the country.
ev.person_leck.opt.dementieren.label: Deny it and stress unity
ev.person_leck.opt.dementieren.beschr: The press keeps digging, but the cabinet does not feel under suspicion.
ev.person_leck.opt.dementieren.ausgang: The government denies it; the paper stands by its story.
ev.person_leck.opt.quelle.label: Find the source
ev.person_leck.opt.quelle.beschr: You confront {wer}: less loyalty, more resentment, but the leak dries up.
ev.person_leck.opt.quelle.ausgang: {wer} denies everything; the leaks stop, but the mistrust in the cabinet does not.
ev.person_leck.opt.aussitzen.label: Sit it out
ev.person_leck.opt.aussitzen.beschr: The story grows, and trust in the country suffers.
ev.person_leck.opt.aussitzen.ausgang: The government stays silent; the paper follows up.
ev.person_leck.standard: With no response the leak becomes a running story: the impression of a divided cabinet sticks.
ev.wahl_stichwahl.text2.ohne_name: The third candidate's voters hold the balance: as things stand about {uebertrag, number} percent of them switch to you, the rest stay at home or vote for your opponent.
ev.katastrophe.tote: {stufe, select, unsicher {It is still unclear how many people have died.} vermutet {Between {nVon, number} and {nBis, number} people are feared dead.} other {{n, plural, =0 {No deaths have been reported so far.} one {One death has been reported.} other {# deaths have been reported.}}}}
ev.grossbeben.titel: {stufe, select, verheerend {Devastating earthquake} schwer {Severe earthquake} other {Strong earthquake}} in {orte, list}
ev.grossbeben.text1: An earthquake of magnitude {mag, number, 1} has struck {orte, list}.
ev.grossbeben.lage: {stufe, select, unsicher {In these first hours it is still unclear how many people have died and how many have lost their homes.} vermutet {First estimates speak of {toteVon, number} to {toteBis, number} dead and {obdVon, number} to {obdBis, number} people left homeless.} other {{tote, plural, one {One death has} other {# deaths have}} been reported, and {obd, number} people have been left homeless.}}
ev.grossbeben.text2: {wer} is asking for instructions. The disaster agency's rescue teams are on their way (readiness {bereit, number} out of 100). What happens now decides how the state will come across in the weeks ahead, and what it promises.
ev.grossbeben.warum: How many people die depends on building quality, earthquake preparedness and the readiness of civil protection (currently {bereit, number} out of 100). {verhindert, plural, =0 {Better preparedness would have brought the death toll down noticeably.} one {Estimates suggest that existing readiness prevented about one death (give or take 25 per cent).} other {Estimates suggest that existing readiness prevented about # deaths (give or take 25 per cent).}} What you promise today will be measured at the end of your term against what has actually been built.
ev.grossbeben.opt.soforthilfe.label: Order emergency aid
ev.grossbeben.opt.soforthilfe.beschr: Rescue, tents and field hospitals; the scale of the damage becomes clear sooner.
ev.grossbeben.opt.versprechen_klein.labe: Emergency aid and a modest promise ({n, number} homes)
ev.grossbeben.opt.versprechen_klein.besc: Some approval now, little promise debt later; emergency aid included.
ev.grossbeben.opt.versprechen_voll.label: Emergency aid and a full promise ({n, number} homes)
ev.grossbeben.opt.versprechen_voll.besch: Noticeable approval now, the full promise debt later; emergency aid included.
ev.grossbeben.opt.versprechen_gross.labe: Emergency aid and a grand promise ({n, number} homes)
ev.grossbeben.opt.versprechen_gross.besc: Plenty of approval now, and a debt that will be measured at the end of your term; emergency aid included.
ev.grossbeben.opt.untersuchung.label: Emergency aid and an inquiry into building inspection
ev.grossbeben.opt.untersuchung.beschr: Honest rather than loud: those who cut corners are held to account and building inspection gets tougher; emergency aid included.
ev.grossbeben.opt.untersuchung.ausgang: {hilfe} An independent inquiry into building inspection begins.
ev.grossbeben.standard: The state responds too late; people in the rubble feel abandoned. Nobody has promised anything, and that will be remembered too.
ev.katastrophe_flut.titel: Flash floods on the Black Sea coast
ev.katastrophe_flut.text1: After days of rain, rivers in {orte, list} have burst their banks, sweeping away houses, bridges and roads.
ev.katastrophe_flut.text2: The disaster agency is asking for instructions; in the valleys, people are holding out on roofs and bridges.
ev.katastrophe_flut.warum: Steep valleys, building along streams and missing flood defences turn heavy rain into disaster; the agency's readiness decides the death toll.
ev.katastrophe_flut.opt.soforthilfe.labe: Emergency aid and evacuation of the danger zones
ev.katastrophe_flut.opt.soforthilfe.besc: Rescue and emergency shelter; the scale of the damage becomes clear sooner.
ev.katastrophe_flut.opt.umsiedlung.label: Emergency aid and moving settlements out of the stream beds
ev.katastrophe_flut.opt.umsiedlung.besch: Roads and bridges are rebuilt away from the streams; those who have to move are angry, and some leave the region.
ev.katastrophe_flut.opt.umsiedlung.ausga: {hilfe} Settlements at risk are moved and roads and bridges rebuilt; those affected protest.
ev.katastrophe_flut.standard: Help arrives late; people in the valleys feel abandoned, and destroyed roads stay closed.
ev.katastrophe_waldbrand.text1: Wildfires are raging in {orte, list}: forests, olive groves and whole neighbourhoods are burning, hotels are being evacuated, and smoke hangs over the coast.
ev.katastrophe_waldbrand.text2: Firefighting aircraft are flying non-stop; the question is what else the state will do.
ev.katastrophe_waldbrand.warum: Hot summers, dry winds and monocultures turn sparks into wildfires; firefighting capacity and readiness decide what is left.
ev.katastrophe_waldbrand.opt.loeschen.la: Mobilise all firefighting capacity and emergency aid
ev.katastrophe_waldbrand.opt.loeschen.be: Saves what can be saved of the tourist season; the scale of the damage becomes clear sooner.
ev.katastrophe_waldbrand.opt.loeschen.au: {hilfe} After several days the fires are under control.
Emergency aid, reforestation and rebuilding the farmsteads
Rural incomes recover and the forest grows back; emergency aid included.
{hilfe} A reforestation programme begins; burnt-out farmsteads are rebuilt.
ev.katastrophe_waldbrand.standard: The fires keep spreading; pictures of burning hotels go round the world, and the tourists stay away.
ev.katastrophe_duerre.titel: Water crisis in the Konya Basin
ev.katastrophe_duerre.text1: In the Konya Basin, wells and reservoirs are running dry: once again the rain has failed, and the water table keeps falling. The basin's farmers drive their tractors up to the provincial capital.
ev.katastrophe_duerre.text2: {wer} points to the state of the budget; the farmers' union demands emergency aid and an irrigation programme.
ev.katastrophe_duerre.warum: The closed basin lives on groundwater. Pump out more than flows back and you reap failed harvests and drifting dunes. The worse the water shortage in the provinces, the likelier this crisis becomes.
ev.katastrophe_duerre.opt.hilfe.label: Emergency aid for the basin's farmers
ev.katastrophe_duerre.opt.hilfe.beschr: Water deliveries and compensation payments keep the farms going through the season.
ev.katastrophe_duerre.opt.bewaesserung.l: Emergency aid and bringing the irrigation programme forward
ev.katastrophe_duerre.opt.bewaesserung.b: Tackles the cause instead of only easing the hardship; the farmers are grateful.
ev.katastrophe_duerre.opt.bewaesserung.a: {hilfe} The irrigation programme is brought forward.
ev.katastrophe_duerre.standard: With no answer, the first farms give up; young people move to the cities.
ev.verfassung.angefochten: The opposition takes the package to the Constitutional Court.
ev.verfassung_abstimmung.titel: Constitutional package: the vote is due
ev.verfassung_abstimmung.text_erledigt: The Grand National Assembly was due to vote on a constitutional package; the procedure is already concluded and the vote will not take place.
ev.verfassung_abstimmung.text1: Today the Grand National Assembly votes on the constitutional package: {paket}.
ev.verfassung_abstimmung.text2: {erwartet, number} yes votes are expected (range {tief, number} to {hoch, number}{absprachen, plural, =0 {} one {, one of them secured by a deal} other {, # of them secured by deals}}). With {direkt, number} votes or more the amendment takes effect directly; between {mehrheit, number} and {bis, number} the people decide; below that the package fails and part of the capital is lost.
ev.verfassung_abstimmung.warum: A constitutional amendment needs a qualified majority. The thresholds decide whether the people get a say.
ev.verfassung_abstimmung.opt.abstimmen.b: The votes are counted: {erwartet, number} yes votes are expected (range {tief, number} to {hoch, number}).
The concluded procedure is taken off the agenda.
ev.verfassung_abstimmung.opt.zurueckzieh: The vote is called off; there will be no second attempt this term.
ev.verfassung_aym.text_erledigt: The Constitutional Court was due to rule on a challenge; the procedure is already concluded and the case is discontinued.
ev.verfassung_aym.text1: The Constitutional Court announces its ruling on the challenge to the package: {paket}.
ev.verfassung_aym.text2: With the bench at {loyal, number} loyal, {unabhaengig, number} independent and {reform, number} reform-minded judges, annulment looks {aussicht, select, gering {rather unlikely} moeglich {possible} other {likely}}. If the court strikes the package down, it has failed; polarisation grows and trust falls.
ev.verfassung_aym.warum: The court rules according to its make-up: whoever shapes the bench shapes the limits of their own power.
ev.verfassung_aym.opt.abwarten.label: Await the ruling
ev.verfassung_aym.opt.abwarten.beschr: The court rules according to its make-up; you can no longer influence it.
ev.verfassung_aym.opt.respektieren.label: Stress the court's independence in public
ev.verfassung_aym.opt.respektieren.besch: You announce that you will respect any ruling; that strengthens compliance with court rulings across the country.
ev.verfassung_aym.opt.respektieren.ausga: The government announces that it will respect any decision. {urteil}
ev.verfassung_referendum.text_erledigt: Polling stations were due to open for a referendum; the procedure is already concluded and there will be no count.
ev.verfassung_referendum.text_ohne_progn: The polling stations close; the procedure is already concluded.
ev.verfassung_referendum.text1: The polls close and the count begins: {paket}.
ev.verfassung_referendum.text2: The last estimate was around {mitte, prozent, 1} yes (range {tief, prozent, 1} to {hoch, prozent, 1}). Behind it: your approval rating ({zustimmung, prozent, 1}), the issues in the articles ({vz}{salienz, number, 1} points) and the campaign (+{kampagne, number, 1} points). At 50 per cent or more the package takes effect; a no costs a great deal of trust, and the parties outside your camp turn away from you.
ev.verfassung_referendum.warum: A referendum is also a vote on the government: your approval carries the yes camp, while the articles and the campaign shift it.
The result is binding: a yes puts the package into force, a no ends it with a heavy loss of trust.
ev.verfassung_referendum.opt.ansprache.b: You call for unity before the result is known; that eases polarisation.
ev.verfassung_referendum.opt.ansprache.a: The address invokes the unity of the country. {ergebnis}
ev.verfassung_proteste.text1: People are gathering in the squares of the big cities against the new constitution: {paket}.
ev.verfassung_proteste.text2: The images go round the world; Strasbourg and the EU read the package as a choice in favour of the Palace, and the markets grow nervous. Whoever rewrites the rules in their own favour pays in legitimacy.
ev.verfassung_proteste.warum: Authoritarian constitutional packages provoke a backlash: the street, foreign capitals and the markets respond to the concentration of power.
ev.verfassung_proteste.opt.dialog.label: Offer dialogue
ev.verfassung_proteste.opt.dialog.beschr: You receive representatives of the protesters; the mood eases and trust rises a little.
ev.verfassung_proteste.opt.dialog.ausgan: Talking to the protesters' representatives takes the edge off the images; the mood eases a little.
ev.verfassung_proteste.opt.polizei.label: Have the police clear the squares
ev.verfassung_proteste.opt.polizei.besch: Quiet fast, and new pictures just as fast: emergency powers reach further, polarisation grows and the country's standing abroad suffers.
ev.verfassung_proteste.opt.polizei.ausga: The police clear the squares; the night is quiet, the pictures are not.
ev.verfassung_proteste.standard: The protests drag on for days and only gradually die down; trust has suffered.
handeln.setzen.text: {name} {ort}: {richtung, select, hoch {raised} other {lowered}} from level {von, number} to {auf, number}.
handeln.setzen.warum: {text} Implementation takes about {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}{kosten, select, kostet {; it costs about {x, prozent, 2} of GDP a year} bringt {; it brings in about {x, prozent, 2} of GDP a year} other {}}.
ev.krieg_drohkulisse.titel: Stand-off: the crisis with {land|dat} comes to a head
ev.krieg_drohkulisse.text1: The incidents with {land|dat} have turned into an open stand-off. The General Staff is presenting situation reports, the parliamentary groups are waiting for a line, and the commentators smell blood.
ev.krieg_drohkulisse.text2: Every move counts now: show readiness, call in a mediator, calm the situation — or declare a war aim that sets the price of every later step. You will find all further steps on the crisis with {land|dat} under “World”.
ev.krieg_drohkulisse.warum: This is where it is decided who controls the situation: whoever is prepared and holds a clear line pays less later.
ev.krieg_drohkulisse.opt.mobil.beschr: The troops stand ready, but the escalation grows; young voters grumble.
ev.krieg_drohkulisse.opt.vermittlung.bes: If it succeeds, the escalation eases markedly; if it fails, standing and trust suffer.
ev.krieg_drohkulisse.opt.deeskalation.be: Tension eases; nationalists read it as weakness.
ev.krieg_drohkulisse.standard: The government does not commit itself; the stand-off continues.
ev.krieg_waffenruhe.text1: An offer arrives through intermediaries: a ceasefire with {land|dat}. The other side seems exhausted — or it is setting a trap to buy time.
ev.krieg_waffenruhe.text2: If the government accepts, the guns fall silent and the negotiating table turns to the border zone, reparations, guarantees and withdrawal. If it refuses, the home front reads it as resolve — and the other side as a sign that its offer is not enough.
ev.krieg_waffenruhe.warum: A ceasefire is not peace: it opens the negotiating table without settling the bill. What peace costs at home also depends on how freely the press may report.
ev.krieg_waffenruhe.opt.annehmen.label: Accept the ceasefire
ev.krieg_waffenruhe.opt.annehmen.beschr: The guns fall silent and the negotiating table opens.
ev.krieg_waffenruhe.opt.ablehnen.label: Refuse and fight on
ev.krieg_waffenruhe.opt.ablehnen.beschr: The war goes on; the home front can bear it, but it grows wearier.
ev.krieg_waffenruhe.opt.ablehnen.ausgang: The government rejects the ceasefire; operations continue.
ev.krieg_waffenruhe.standard: Without a reply the offer lapses; the war goes on and the home front grows wearier.
ev.putschgeruechte.titel: Coup rumours in the General Staff
ev.putschgeruechte.text1: After the military humiliation, officers are talking openly about the government's responsibility. Trust in the officer corps stands at {n, number} out of 100 — it is broken.
ev.putschgeruechte.text2: Names are circulating in the barracks. The intelligence service presents lists; the question is whether the government disciplines the military leadership or brings it on board before others seize the initiative.
ev.putschgeruechte.warum: Lost territory and defeat are the classic triggers of a coup: an officer corps that blames the government for the damage needs only a pretext.
ev.putschgeruechte.opt.ordnung.label: Call the generals to order
ev.putschgeruechte.opt.ordnung.beschr: The ranks close for now, but the officers' trust and the government's legitimacy fall.
ev.putschgeruechte.opt.ordnung.ausgang: The government publicly rebukes the outspoken generals; the corps obeys — and remembers the tone.
ev.putschgeruechte.opt.einbinden.label: Bring the officers on board
ev.putschgeruechte.opt.einbinden.beschr: The corps feels taken seriously; nationalists and some voters see it as caving in.
ev.putschgeruechte.opt.einbinden.ausgang: A special staff of officers is to work through the humiliation; the corps feels taken seriously.
ev.putschgeruechte.standard: Unanswered, the rumours keep growing; the corps reads the silence as weakness.
ev.krieg_beistandsruf.titel: Call for assistance: {partner|akk|anfang} {nz, select, pl {are} other {is}} under attack
ev.krieg_beistandsruf.text1: {gegner|akk|anfang} {gnz, select, pl {have} other {has}} attacked {partner|akk}. {partner|akk|anfang} {nz, select, pl {invoke} other {invokes}} {pakt} and {nz, select, pl {call} other {calls}} for assistance.
ev.krieg_beistandsruf.text3: Pledging support now binds Türkiye to a war; staying silent or refusing puts at risk the partner's trust, a treaty and Türkiye's standing as an ally. Materiel and diplomacy are the middle way.
ev.krieg_beistandsruf.warum: A pact is only tested when it matters; that moment has come. It will show whether the promise was more than paper.
ev.krieg_beistandsruf.pakt.golf: the Gulf Cooperation Council's defence agreement
ev.krieg_beistandsruf.pakt.sco: the charter of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation
ev.krieg_beistandsruf.klausel.kollektiv: The clause: an attack on one is an attack on all.
ev.krieg_beistandsruf.klausel.beistand: The clause: if a partner is attacked, the others owe it aid and assistance.
ev.krieg_beistandsruf.klausel.konsultati: The clause: the partners consult each other; there is no duty to assist.
ev.krieg_beistandsruf.klausel.keine: There is no duty to assist.
ev.krieg_beistandsruf.klausel.ohne: The General Staff presents situation reports; the Foreign Ministry advises caution.
ev.krieg_beistandsruf.opt.truppen.label: Pledge military assistance
ev.krieg_beistandsruf.opt.truppen.beschr: A stand-off with {gegner|dat} begins, with “assistance” declared as the war aim; a deployment still needs a decision.
ev.krieg_beistandsruf.opt.material.label: Materiel and diplomacy
ev.krieg_beistandsruf.opt.material.besch: {partner|akk|anfang} {nz, select, pl {get} other {gets}} weapons, money and an advocate while the troops stay at home; the obligation is half met.
ev.krieg_beistandsruf.opt.material.ausga: Ankara sends materiel and stands diplomatically with {partner|dat}; the troops stay at home.
ev.krieg_beistandsruf.opt.verweigern.bes: {partner|akk|anfang} {nz, select, pl {lose} other {loses}} trust in Türkiye, Türkiye's standing falls, and a treaty with a defence clause records a violation.
ev.krieg_beistandsruf.opt.verweigern.aus: Ankara refuses assistance; {partner|akk} {nz, select, pl {see} other {sees}} it as a broken promise.{vertrag}
ev.krieg_beistandsruf.standard: Ankara leaves the call unanswered; {partner|akk} {nz, select, pl {see} other {sees}} it as a broken promise.{vertrag}
ev.welt_machtwechsel.text1: New leadership has taken over in {land|dat}. {kurs, select, hart {It is taking a harder line towards Ankara.} nah {It is seeking closer ties with Ankara.} other {It is keeping to the previous line towards Ankara.}} The country has {wachstum, prozent, 1} growth and {inflation, prozent, 1} inflation; the situation is considered {lage}.
ev.welt_machtwechsel.text2: The Foreign Minister sets out three options: congratulate at once and extend an invitation, wait and watch the new course, or put Türkiye's own demands on the table straight away.
ev.welt_machtwechsel.warum: Other countries also hold elections and topple governments; a change alters what Ankara can expect from them.
ev.welt_machtwechsel.opt.gratulieren.bes: An early visit improves relations, especially if the new leadership is already seeking closer ties.
ev.welt_machtwechsel.opt.gratulieren.aus: Ankara congratulates {land|dat} at once and extends an invitation: {kurs, select, nah {the invitation is warmly received.} hart {the gesture softens the harder tone a little.} other {relations warm.}}
ev.welt_machtwechsel.opt.abwarten.label: Wait and see
ev.welt_machtwechsel.opt.abwarten.beschr: Ankara watches the course first; a new leadership with a hard line reads the silence as weakness.
ev.welt_machtwechsel.opt.abwarten.ausgan: Ankara waits and watches the new course in {land|dat}.{kurs, select, hart { The new leadership reads the silence as weakness.} other {}}
ev.welt_machtwechsel.opt.fordern.label: Set out our own demands
ev.welt_machtwechsel.opt.fordern.beschr: Making demands early shapes the start; with a hard-line leadership it escalates, otherwise it sends a strong signal.
ev.welt_machtwechsel.opt.fordern.ausgang: The demands meet a leadership that is looking for a fight: relations deteriorate.
The demands are taken seriously: {land|akk} {nz, select, pl {promise} other {promises}} to look into them.
ev.welt_machtwechsel.standard: Ankara lets the change of leadership in {land|dat} pass without comment.{kurs, select, hart { The new leadership reads the silence as weakness.} other {}}
ev.welt_krise.titel: {art, select, waehrung {Currency crisis} zahlungsausfall {Sovereign default} grenzkrise {Border clashes} other {Unrest}} in {land|dat}
ev.welt_krise.lage.waehrung: Inflation in {land|dat} stands at {inflation, prozent, 1} and the deficit at {defizit, prozent, 1} of GDP.
ev.welt_krise.lage.zahlungsausfall: Debt stands at {schulden, prozent, 0} of GDP; {land|akk} can no longer service it.
ev.welt_krise.lage.grenzkrise: Tension between {land|dat} and a neighbour has risen so far that fighting has broken out; stability stands at {stab, number} out of 100.
ev.welt_krise.lage.unruhen: Stability in {land|dat} stands at {stab, number} out of 100, and support for the leadership at {rueckhalt, number}.
ev.welt_krise.text2: A lot is at stake for Türkiye: trade, border security and the question of who gains influence in {land|dat} if nobody helps. The staff proposes helping now, securing the borders or standing by.
ev.welt_krise.warum: High inflation, debt and unrest plunge countries into crisis; the neighbours feel it first.
ev.welt_krise.opt.helfen.label: Offer financial help and support
ev.welt_krise.opt.helfen.beschr: The crisis subsides faster and {land|akk} {nz, select, pl {draw} other {draws}} closer to Ankara.
ev.welt_krise.opt.helfen.ausgang: Ankara helps {land|dat}: stability recovers to {stab, number} out of 100 and trust grows.
ev.welt_krise.opt.sichern.label: Tighten border controls
ev.welt_krise.opt.sichern.beschr: Türkiye shields itself from the fallout but does not help; relations cool.
ev.welt_krise.opt.sichern.ausgang: Ankara tightens checks at borders and ports on everything coming from {land|dat}: the consequences for Türkiye stay limited, but relations cool.
ev.welt_krise.standard: Ankara stands by during the crisis in {land|dat}: exports suffer, security worsens, and {land|akk} {nz, select, pl {remember} other {remembers}} who did not help.
ev.welt_einfluss.text1.einfluss: The intelligence service reports: {land|akk} {nz, select, pl {are} other {is}} trying to influence the election in Türkiye — money, media and networks are meant to turn the mood.
ev.welt_einfluss.text1.medien: The intelligence service reports: {land|akk} {nz, select, pl {are} other {is}} running a media campaign against Türkiye — targeted disinformation is meant to weaken the government.
ev.welt_einfluss.text1.abhoeren: The intelligence service reports: {land|akk} {nz, select, pl {are} other {is}} eavesdropping on conversations in the Presidency.
ev.welt_einfluss.text2: The staff proposes three responses: reinforce the service and intercept quietly, go public, or tighten the media law. Doing nothing lets the operation run on.
ev.welt_einfluss.warum: Other states run influence operations against Türkiye, above all in the months before an election and at times of high tension; not everything is discovered.
ev.welt_einfluss.opt.gegenspionage.label: Step up counter-intelligence
ev.welt_einfluss.opt.gegenspionage.besch: Intercepts most of it and makes further discoveries more likely, but ties up around {anteil, prozent, 0} of the intelligence service's capacity.
ev.welt_einfluss.opt.oeffentlich.label: Go public and summon the ambassador
ev.welt_einfluss.opt.oeffentlich.beschr: The government gains support, but relations cool.
ev.welt_einfluss.opt.mediengesetz.label: Tighten the media law
ev.welt_einfluss.opt.mediengesetz.beschr: The campaign loses its footing, but press freedom and the EU's trust suffer.
ev.welt_einfluss.opt.mediengesetz.ausgan: A tougher media law cuts the ground from under the campaign; critics and Brussels see it as a step against press freedom.
ev.welt_einfluss.opt.gegenspionage.ausga: The service steps up counter-intelligence and intercepts most of the interference; only a small part gets through.
ev.welt_einfluss.opt.oeffentlich.ausgang: Ankara makes the interference public and summons the ambassador: the government gains support, and {land|akk} {nz, select, pl {react} other {reacts}} with irritation.
ev.welt_einfluss.standard.einfluss: Ankara does not respond: the interference carries on and costs public support.
ev.welt_einfluss.opt.gegenspionage.ausga: The service steps up counter-intelligence and intercepts most of the media campaign; only a small part gets through.
ev.welt_einfluss.opt.oeffentlich.ausgang: Ankara makes the media campaign public and summons the ambassador: the government gains support, and {land|akk} {nz, select, pl {react} other {reacts}} with irritation.
ev.welt_einfluss.standard.medien: Ankara does not respond: the media campaign carries on and costs public support.
ev.welt_einfluss.opt.gegenspionage.ausga: The service steps up counter-intelligence and intercepts most of the eavesdropping; only a small part gets through.
ev.welt_einfluss.opt.oeffentlich.ausgang: Ankara makes the eavesdropping public and summons the ambassador: the government gains support, and {land|akk} {nz, select, pl {react} other {reacts}} with irritation.
ev.welt_einfluss.standard.abhoeren: Ankara does not respond: the eavesdropping carries on and costs Türkiye's standing.
ev.welt_einfluss.notiz.fakt: Ankara goes public: {art} by {land|dat}; the ambassador is summoned.
ev.vermittlung.konflikt.isr_irn.titel: Israel and Iran: the Hormuz fallout
ev.vermittlung_spoiler.art.provokation: {seite|anfang} is flexing its muscles: an incident on the line, a speech for the home crowd — in the hope that the table in Istanbul collapses.
ev.vermittlung_spoiler.art.hardliner: Hardliners gain the upper hand in {seite|dat}: anyone who talks of compromise is suddenly branded a traitor, and the delegation loses its mandate.
ev.vermittlung_spoiler.art.sabotage: A third power that profits from the conflict is torpedoing the rapprochement: leaks, arms deliveries to the spoilers, a staged incident.
ev.vermittlung_spoiler.art.ultimatum: {seite|anfang} publicly hardens its conditions: what was negotiable yesterday is declared a precondition — an ultimatum that narrows the room for a deal.
ev.vermittlung_spoiler.text2: The rapprochement has come a long way: the situation's ripeness stands at {reif, number} out of 100. Whoever fears a settlement has the greatest interest in damaging it now.
ev.vermittlung_spoiler.warum: Spoilers are the classic reason mediations fail: those who profit from the conflict strike just as a settlement draws near. Every response sends a signal — to the spoilers, to the other side and about Ankara's own credibility as a mediator.
ev.vermittlung_spoiler.opt.verurteilen.b: A clear stand against the spoilers: {andere} feels protected, {seite} is annoyed.
ev.vermittlung_spoiler.opt.verurteilen.a: Ankara publicly condemns the attempt to wreck the talks: {andere} feels protected, {seite} responds coolly — but the negotiating line holds.
ev.vermittlung_spoiler.opt.daempfen.besc: The damage stays small and nobody loses face.
ev.vermittlung_spoiler.opt.daempfen.ausg: Ankara calms both sides through discreet channels: the damage stays small and nobody loses face.
ev.vermittlung_spoiler.opt.ignorieren.be: The spoilers take it as a free pass; the situation becomes less ripe for a deal.
ev.vermittlung_spoiler.opt.ignorieren.au: Ankara stays silent — and the spoilers take it as a free pass: the situation's ripeness falls by {n, number} points.
ev.vermittlung_verstoss.text1: The agreed implementation between {a|dat} and {b|dat} has broken down: violations on the line, blocked steps, recriminations on both sides. Ankara guarantees the agreement — now the world is watching the guarantor.
ev.vermittlung_verstoss.text2.militaer: The military guarantee leaves little room: intervene and enforce the agreement, calm things on every channel — or accept the guarantor's loss of face.
ev.vermittlung_verstoss.text2: The guarantee leaves some room: calm things down and save the agreement — or accept the breach and lose the guarantee.
ev.vermittlung_verstoss.warum: A guarantee buys responsibility: the guarantor is judged by the first breach. Enforcing costs money and carries risk, calming things down sets the process back, and accepting it costs face — perhaps the whole mediation.
ev.vermittlung_verstoss.opt.eingreifen.b: Costly, and the conflict flares up; but the guarantee holds and Ankara's standing rises.
ev.vermittlung_verstoss.opt.eingreifen.a: Turkish forces enforce the guarantee: the breach is repelled, the agreement stands — and everyone knows Ankara means it.
ev.vermittlung_verstoss.opt.eingreifen.o: Without a military guarantee there is nothing to enforce.
ev.vermittlung_verstoss.opt.daempfen.bes: The guarantee stands, but both sides learn that breaches come cheap.
ev.vermittlung_verstoss.opt.daempfen.aus: Ankara calms things on every channel: the guarantee still stands, but both sides have learned that breaches come cheap.
ev.vermittlung_verstoss.opt.hinnehmen.be: The guarantee collapses: Ankara loses face and the process falls back.
ev.vermittlung_verstoss.opt.hinnehmen.au: The breach goes unanswered: {art, select, ueberwachung {Ankara's guarantee, the monitoring mission, is broken} wirtschaft {Ankara's guarantee, the economic anchor, is broken} militaer {Ankara's military guarantee is broken} other {Ankara's guarantee is broken}} — Ankara loses face and the process falls back.
ev.eu_veto.text1: The criteria for {kapitel} would be met — but {land|akk} vetoes it in the Council of the European Union. Enlargement requires unanimity; a single member is enough.
ev.eu_veto.text2: The Foreign Minister sets out two options: a visible concession that defuses the dispute and lifts the veto — or waiting for the situation to turn, which leaves the chapter blocked for a year.
ev.eu_veto.warum: Greece and Cyprus use their veto against every EU step towards Ankara for as long as the disputes remain open.
ev.eu_veto.opt.zugestaendnis.label: Offer a concession
ev.eu_veto.opt.zugestaendnis.beschr: Defuses the dispute and lifts the veto; nationalists see it as giving in.
ev.eu_veto.opt.abwarten.label: Wait
ev.eu_veto.opt.abwarten.beschr: {kapitel|anfang} stays blocked for {jahre, plural, one {a year} other {# years}} and Brussels loses some trust.
ev.eu_zollunion.titel: Brussels offers a mandate to modernise the customs union
ev.eu_zollunion.text1: With the chapters closed, Türkiye has come far enough: Brussels offers a mandate to modernise the 1995 customs union — services, public procurement and agriculture are on the table.
ev.eu_zollunion.text2: Modernisation is a real milestone with a real price: industry and exporters gain access, while agriculture loses its protective tariffs and faces competition. Refusing means waiting years for the next offer.
ev.eu_zollunion.warum: {n, plural, one {One closed chapter has} other {# closed chapters have}} made the offer possible.
ev.eu_zollunion.opt.annehmen.label: Accept the mandate
ev.eu_zollunion.opt.annehmen.beschr: Exports, industry and investment gain, and the risk premium falls by {punkte, number} points; agriculture loses its tariff protection.
ev.eu_zollunion.opt.ablehnen.label: Decline
ev.eu_zollunion.opt.ablehnen.beschr: The offer is postponed for {jahre, plural, one {a year} other {# years}} and Brussels loses trust.
